tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i chos srid la dge legs 'byung ba'i sgo shis brjod phun tshogs gtsug rgyan bzhugs so// swasti/ phun tshogs kun gyi gtsug rgyan rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bkra shis dam pa des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen phreng / /chad med myur du 'byon pa'i bkra shis shog /mdo rgyud man ngag rig gnas kun spel ba'i/ /'phags bod brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen phreng / /chad med myur du 'byon pa'i bkra shis shog /byang phyogs thub pa'i rgyal tshab sa skya pa/ /yab sras gong ma lnga nas yab rdo rje 'chang gi bar sogs/ rjes ngor rdzong gong tshar g.yag rong go shākya 'bum gsum sogs shin tu mang ngo 'brangs mkhas grub bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen phreng / /chad med myur du 'byon pa'i bkra shis shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam chos dge 'dun bcas/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i༞ /chad med myur༞ /tshangs spyod grub mtha' rigs bzhi rjes bzung ba'i/ /rgyud bzhi'i yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i༞ /chad med myur du༞ /yang phur kyai rdor bde mchog gsang ba 'dus/ /tshe dpag med sogs lhag lha'i bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i༞ /chad med myur du༞ /bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten legs skyong ba'i/ /bka' bstod dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i༞ /chad med myur du༞ /lcam dral lha brgyad gur zhal nor skyong dkar bdud phur srung sogs/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan srung bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i༞ /chad med myur du༞ /phongs pa kun sel dgos 'dod char 'bebs pa'i/ /dpal 'byor dbang phyug nor lha'i bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i༞ /chad med myur du༞ /dmar po skor gsum dzaṃ dbyug rnam sras sogs/

/sa skya'i rje btsun dbang lha'i bkra shis des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i༞ /chad med myur du༞ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'gro la rjes brtse dang / /spyi dang bye brag gdul bya'i gsol btab mthus/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i༞ /chad med myur du༞ /mkhas btsun bzang ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs kun/ /zhabs pad brtan cing bzhed dgongs mthar phyin nas/ /'gro ba kun la 'phral yun phan bde'i sgo/ /dge legs phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bdag gi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba dang / /lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen phreng / /srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rabs myur 'byon gyi bkra shis 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra dgos 'dod char 'bebs la rab gnas brgya tshar gyi dbu tshugs skabs lcags 'brug smin drug zla ba'i tshes nyi shu rgyal phur 'grub sbyor gyi nyin sbyar ba'i bkra shis des rang re'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi dgongs bzhed dang / spyi bye brag gi gdul bya'i re ba bzhin lha rigs 'khon gdung sa skya pa zhes mtshan mchog gsum ldan gdung rabs mkhas grub rin po che'i phreng ba ltar/ bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor 'byung gnas 'di nyid la da dung sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul rgyun mi chad par byon nas srid mtha'i bar du dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //ces pa'i yi ge pa ni deng sang rigs dang tsha bo dar ba gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sa skya'i chos srid la dge legs 'byung ba'i sgo shis brjod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
